proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_type×regime×sector + by_signal_type = Choppy regime (100%), UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell (25%), UP_TRI signal (90%) (100.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type×regime×sector + by_signal_type = Choppy regime (100%), UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell (25%), UP_TRI signal (90%); recommended action: Pause all new UP_TRI entries in Bank sector until UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell share drops below 0.20 via natural Day-6 exits; additionally pause new BULL_PROXY entries and prefer any non-directional or DOWN_TRI setup to break the 100% directional-long monoculture. Do not add to Choppy regime exposure while regime concentration remains at 100%.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If Choppy regime flips to Bear (or a sharp Bank-sector sell-off hits on unvalidated Choppy×UP_TRI edge), the entire 20-position book takes correlated drawdown simultaneously — Bank cell alone (25%) plus Metal (15%) means ~40% of book is in two cyclical sectors with no hedge, and the Candidate-tier cohort provides no historical basis to expect the setup to hold through a regime shift.

evidence: All 5 concentrated cells map to Choppy×UP_TRI cohort at Candidate tier (n=275) — unvalidated edge
Extends multi-week warn streak of regime + directional-long monoculture on unvalidated cohort
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.concentration_value: Choppy regime (100%), UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell (25%), UP_TRI signal (90%)
decision_metadata.recommended_action: Pause all new UP_TRI entries in Bank sector until UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell share drops below 0.20 via natural Day-6 exits; additionally pause new BULL_PROXY entries and prefer any non-directional or DOWN_TRI setup to break the 100% directional-long monoculture. decision_metadata.tail_risk_scenario: If Choppy regime flips to Bear (or a sharp Bank-sector sell-off hits on unvalidated Choppy×UP_TRI edge), the entire 20-position book takes correlated drawdown simultaneously — Bank cell alone (25%) plus Metal (15%) means ~40% of book is in two cyclical sectors with no hedge, and the Candidate-tier cohort provides no historical basis to expect the setup to hold through a regime shift.
decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration is triggered at 100% Choppy (20/20, well above the 0.80 threshold) AND the UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell breaches the 0.20 cell threshold at 25% (5/20). UP_TRI dominates signal mix at 18/20 = 90% (above 0.85) and combined with BULL_PROXY the book is 20/20 = 100% directional-long — a full monoculture. All concentrated cells match only the Candidate-tier Choppy×UP_TRI cohort (n=275) — unvalidated edge, extending a multi-week warn streak.
